title: Joinery Installation
status: Draft spot check from ITPs – for agreement

questions.q: Timber moisture 8–12% and storage conditions logged?
questions.source: Atlantic ITP – temperature, humidity & moisture check

questions.q: Datum levels marked; backgrounds flat to 3 mm in 2 m before fixing?
Ask the fitter: What margins are you working to between doors and panels? Could they answer?
questions.source: SuperPrime site practice – a fitter who can't answer is a red flag

questions.q: Joinery plumb, level and in line – within 2 mm over the run?
Perimeter gap at least 10 mm plus 2 mm per metre run on long runs (movement)?
Are fixings accurate and concealed, with cantilevers no more than 150 mm?
Is the work protected and free from damage?
Mastic depth at least 10 mm where joinery is sealed?

notOk.t: Cabinet or mirror doors missing, misaligned or springing on hinges
Unequal margins between doors, drawers and panels
Chips, marks or glue on veneer and lacquer
Panelling setting out not matching the drawing
Shadow gaps to stone and panelling untidy
